bear_assumptions: About USD 3.5 billion forward revenue at roughly 6x enterprise value/revenue; deployments slip, utilization or pricing weakens, customer advances do not repeat, capex and secured funding rise, and dilution persists.
base_assumptions: About USD 5.5 billion forward revenue at roughly 9x; contracted capacity is delivered, AI-cloud adjusted EBITDA remains positive, capex financing broadly tracks deployments, and dilution is contained but material.
bull_assumptions: About USD 8.0 billion forward revenue at roughly 13x; large contracts ramp on schedule, software and utilization sustain strong margins, asset-backed funding scales efficiently, and customer diversity improves.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh evidence and a new scenario set clear the expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence, and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade if contracted deployments slip or reprice, utilization or margin scaling disappoints, customer advances reverse without durable cash generation, capex and financing outrun unit economics, secured leverage or dilution rises materially, or customer concentration worsens.
